item.title: Wanted man spotted and stopped near Ruston
item.description: A man stopped and arrested on outstanding warrants was additionally charged with drug offenses after suspected methamphetamine was found on him at the Lincoln Parish Detention Center. Zachary Fisher, 36, of Ruston, was stopped Sunday afternoon when Lincoln Parish deputies saw his gray Mazda traveling south on U.S. 167 and recognized it as Fisher’s vehicle. … Continue reading Wanted man spotted and stopped near Ruston

item.title: All Shook Up: Earthquakes rattle NW La.
item.description: by Wesley Harris A 4.9-magnitude earthquake briefly rocked portions of northwest Louisiana about 5:30 Thursday morning but apparently caused no damage. Several Lincoln Parish residents felt the tremors, including in Simsboro, Dubach and Ruston.
